rootZone.storageBasis: Plant-available root-zone water relative to wilting point; 0 mm is at wilting point and TAW (160 mm) is at field capacity under this single-bucket convention.

dailyEnvironment.weatherStatus: Synthetic single-day forcing. Temperature, DLI, and GDD base retain the ancillary reducer routing values from the referenced dry-down fixture; only precipitation and ETo are overridden for this case.

expected.equations: FAO-56 Eq. 82: TAW = AWC × effective root depth. Initial depletion = TAW - initial plant-available storage. FAO-56 Eq. 88, with capillary rise fixed at 0 for this fixture: deep percolation = max(0, (precipitation - runoff) + irrigation - ETc - initial depletion). FAO-56 Eq. 85 then gives end depletion = initial depletion - (precipitation - runoff) - irrigation - capillary rise + ETc + deep percolation, bounded by 0..TAW under Eq. 86; end storage = TAW - end depletion. The storage-form residual is initial storage + inflows - runoff - deep percolation - actual ETc - end storage. The existing v2 reducer computes drainage from pre-ET overflow; because ETc is 0 in this case, its result equals the cited equations. Nonzero same-day ET/overflow ordering is not covered.

integratedPreStepState.rootDevelopment: none; no runtime rootDevelopment parameter is supplied; fixed effectiveRootDepthCm=80 cm

storedReducerObservables.deepPercolationObservation: The direct stepFao56RootZone result exposes deepDrainageMm=4. The engine does not persist a dedicated daily drainage field. The one-cell stepDay/simulateRun path must independently show exact effective precipitation, unrounded zero water use, final storage and zero residual so the integrated 4 mm is implied by the mass balance under the standard route with runoff fixed at 0. Do not describe deep drainage as a persisted output. This zero-ET fixture does not test nonzero same-day ET/overflow ordering.

directRootZoneStep.input: RootZoneState waterMm=159; awcMmPerCm=2; effectiveRootDepthCm=80; depletionFraction=0.6; precipMm=5; runoffMm=0; irrigationMm=0; capillaryRiseMm=0; rootGrowthStorageMm=0; potentialTranspirationMm=0.

stepDayAndRunAssertions.configRoute: One planted cell; crop-model-v2 frozen inputs; standard open-field path without environment-v2; no environment climate snapshot.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.stepDay: Before the tick, createRun's cell rootZoneWaterMm is exactly 159 and root-zone capacity is exactly 160 mm from frozen AWC 2 mm/cm × fixed effective depth 80 cm. The frozen rootDevelopment is none and no root-growth storage is added. effectiveEnv.precipMm is exactly 5; dayStats.waterUseMm is exactly 0 (unrounded); final cell rootZoneWaterMm is 160; cell accumulated and max absolute residuals are 0.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.simulateRun: One-day summary rainMm is 5 and waterUseMm is 0; the same frozen pre-step state is rootZoneWaterMm=159 with capacity 160 mm; rootDevelopment is none and root-growth storage is 0; final cell root-zone water is 160; aggregate accumulated and maximum absolute residuals are 0.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.inference: With a one-cell normal v2 root step, precipitation 5 mm, engine runoff fixed at 0, other inflows 0, unrounded actual water use 0, initial storage 159 mm, final storage 160 mm, and stored residual 0, the mass balance implies exactly 4 mm deep drainage. Summary rain/water-use fields are rounded to 0.1 mm and are not the sole proof; assert stepDay effectiveEnv and dayStats values.
